steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each risk is placed by its owner and its review date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Review date has passed
findings.fix: Review the risk and set the next date

findings.title: Rating does not match the exposure

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

[high] ops-risk-03.md:12  Review date has passed.
       Fix: Review the risk and set the next date.
[medium] ops-risk-02.md:19  Risk with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
[low] ops-risk-05.md:26  Rating does not match the exposure.
       Fix: Re-rate the risk.
Not checked: Whether a risk is real.
pros: Checks a rating that does not match, a review date passed, and a risk with no owner.
cons: Not checked: Whether a risk is real.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ops-risk-register skill on the records for this review.
